text:
Aisha (People Ops): Starting a quick thread for clarifying items from today's all-hands about reviews, comp, and appeals. Short answers only so folks can copy notes.

Maya (Senior Eng): When are manager signoffs due?

Aisha (People Ops): Manager signoff (final PDFs) due 2025-04-04 EOD PT.

Luis (IC): If promoted, does the raise apply retroactively?

Dana (HR): Default = effective on publish date. Retro pay possible with business case + Finance approval.

Maya (Senior Eng): Any dollar threshold for extra approvals?

payroll-bot: Note from Finance: retroactive amounts > $5,000 require VP Finance sign-off and are processed in the next payroll cycle.

Luis (IC): Appeals window?

Dana (HR): 14 days after publish. Use the HR appeal form; we respond within 7 business days.

Nina (People Ops Intern): Manager summary template will be posted to #people-ops-resources and emailed by EOD.

Maya (Senior Eng): Can we get a 1-page checklist?

Aisha (People Ops): Copyable checklist: - Draft ratings + comments by 2025-04-01 - Upload signed summary by 2025-04-04 - Confirm calibration attendees by 2025-04-07 - Flag retroactive pay asks by 2025-04-02 - Attach 3 examples for promotion nominees

Luis (IC): Will calibration notes be shared?

Dana (HR): You get outcomes + anonymized notes, not individual reviewer comments.

Aisha (People Ops): If you need a prep 1:1, book People Ops office hours. Tag me for urgent cases. :raised_hands:
